name: GE® ENERGY STAR® 36" 27.9 Cu. Ft. Black Side-by-Side Refrigerator with Extra Tall Dispenser and In-Door Icemaker
shortDescription: It's easy to stay organized with extra room to store large or bulk food items with 27.9 cubic feet of storage space. Store more of your favorite tall items like two-liters, and take advantage of wide, wall-to-wall glass shelves - perfect for party platters and more - offering adjustable organization at every level.

features.text: Easily access filtered water and ice from an extra tall, 11-inch dispenser made to fill everyone in the family's favorite water bottle.
Located on the door to create more usable storage space in the freezer. Dispense cubed and crushed ice through the door.

Move the clear door bins up and down to fit your storage needs – whether it’s large gallons, tall bottles, or everyday essentials. Two of the fresh food bins are extra large, which means you can fit two gallons of milk plus more, all in just one bin.
With two fridge drawers and a separate freezer drawer, there's a place for everything - from fresh fruit to frozen fruit - so your family always knows where to look.
Find exactly what you're looking for under crisp, clear lighting
Multiple vents distribute air flow to help keep set temperatures consistent.
Protect your groceries with a door alarm that signals when the fresh food or freezer door has been accidentally left open.
The included refrigerator water filter reduces 50+ impurities including lead, chlorine, microplastics, and PFOA/PFOS; providing clean, safe drinking water and ice.
